s02075.summary: Wren and Dottie idle in the car wash booth as Hank checks in
Dottie and Wren puzzle over a crossword clue about wanting elsewhere
Dottie realizes Wren never applied to the Duluth program
They laugh at the old joke about Wren being a bad influence
Wren asks if people will be mad if she stays; Dottie says a week
Dottie hits the emergency stop and the tunnel falls silent
Wren fills in a word that fits, and Dottie briefly leans on her
Headlights approach unnoticed while Wren buys Dottie an orange pop
A car idles at the tunnel and Hank says they are closed
Dottie sends the car away and returns; Wren laughs properly

s02086.summary: Madame and Pietro bake in the floating bakery above Venus
Dispatch warns of a cloud shear and Pietro grows nervous
Madame refuses to shut the ovens and tells Pietro to calm his nerves
Inspector Loganathan staggers in announcing a surprise audit
The floor drops as everyone braces and trades deadpan quips
The shear hits, the kitchen spins, then everything settles
Madame tastes a floor cake and the inspector awards a pass

s00703.summary: Under shelling Ostrander hesitates before radioing Battalion
Ostrander reports heavy losses and asks to fall back
Battalion orders him to hold; Ostrander laughs and expects them late
Ostrander hangs up and listens in the dark

s01763.summary: Trapped survivors wait in the tunnel as Magda insists rescue knows
Bea comforts pregnant Ximena and asks about the baby
Old Teo plays harmonica and the group falls silent
Joaquin regrets the late train; Bea mentions her grandma at Elm
Magda rations water and a granola bar, which they share around
Concrete groans overhead and the light flickers
Teo asks Bea to hum and joins her on harmonica

s00112.summary: Four survivors huddle in a lifeboat; Pia teases exhausted Baz
Magnus spots a smoke trail on the horizon
Magnus forbids firing the flare yet despite Baz and Pia's urging
They wait as a grey steel hull approaches
Magnus orders the shot; Delphine fires and all four scream

s00522.summary: Isolde walks the car deck checking vehicles against her list
Isolde chats with passengers Rafferty, Jung-Ho and Winnie
The bridge says the manifest has forty cars, not forty-one
Isolde recounts, deflects Rafferty, and returns to the white van
The unlisted van is locked and Jung-Ho says nobody left it
Rafferty warns Isolde back; she hears an electric whine
Isolde orders the car deck evacuated as passengers scramble
A gloved hand sets a black box on the deck
Rafferty shouts, Isolde pulls Winnie out, and the box turns red

s01813.summary: At night court the judge arraigns a nameless man in a gown
Mercedes details the shark tank trespass while Leon begs his client silent
The man says he was looking for Marisol who lives in the tank
He remembers he is Corwin, a marine biologist and repeat offender
The judge releases Corwin on condition he stays out of the tank

s00870.summary: Coworkers gather at a joyless mandatory fun tent in a garage
Desmond's cheer meets silence and deadpan replies
Desmond insists Takeshi's ordinary balloon is a safety balloon
Lola and Desmond fight over cake and Lola logs an incident
Takeshi asks to leave and Anouk previews her cake report
Everyone tries to leave, fails, and drifts back; Desmond toasts alone

s01189.summary: Dr. Nair hurries through a cinema turned field hospital
Priya examines the feverish boy and questions his father
Out of antibiotics, Priya orders a double dose and a pharmacist
Theo asks if his son will live; Priya honestly says she doesn't know
Called away, Priya turns back to tuck in the boy
The generator fails and the hall plunges into darkness
Sebastian brings a retired pharmacist and Priya enlists her
Priya refuses Theo's thanks and keeps vigil beside the boy

s00334.summary: Cornelia deposes Desmond, who claims he never keeps customer property
Cornelia reveals an extra animal is her client's dead Great Dane
They stare; Desmond demands a lawyer and both rise at once

s02050.summary: Kira pulls a panel from the belt with a scratched-out name
Dmitri approaches and orders Kira to put the warm panel back
Inspector Leopoldine enters, belts stop, and she asks for Asante-Volkov

s00594.summary: Gloria and Walter sit silently in a hospital waiting room
Gloria asks Walter to say anything; he manages a little
The doctor summons them and they freeze before the door
Gloria refuses to take her time and they walk in together

s00573.summary: Pilgrims and a silent stranger approach Mawdley's toll on the rib bridge
Mawdley demands a toll, raising it when Rook grumbles
Mawdley challenges the ragged stranger, and Tamsin glares him down
The ribs hum and Rook orders everyone back
The stranger reveals she is Zephyrine, builder of the bridge

s01153.summary: Issa's crew scans a lifeless derelict; Rook questions staying
Tarquin feels a chill as Issa pushes Rook to dock faster
A looping distress hail arrives from the supposedly empty derelict
Issa resolves to board alone despite Rook's objection
Jonah appears in the airlock, armed, survivor of fourteen months
Jonah warns something else is using his voice in the loop
Issa sounds the alarm and orders the hull link severed
A light on the derelict turns toward them; Jonah says too late

s02243.summary: Sandhu examines a dead parrot and questions staff about the keys
Sandhu sees the tag reads Percival and freezes
Sandhu orders everyone out and they scatter

s01380.summary: Rhea sits alone in the empty courtroom staring at the verdict
Walter brings coffee; they wince in unison at its taste
Walter tries to say good trial; Rhea notes he won
Walter tidies the jury box and Rhea teases his habit
They argue the nineteen-year-old's sentence against the boy he killed
Rhea admits she felt on the wrong side, yet someone had to be
Their cups meet and Walter asks her for a drink; she defers
Rhea leaves telling him to fix the chairs, and he does

s01826.summary: Vinnie counts cash for Lorne and shorts him over the plates
Everyone watches each other warily in the cramped back room
Lorne asks about Marisol and she unnerves him until Vinnie seats her
Darius notes the duffel is short and Vinnie explains the double count
Lorne demands to know what's in the duffel and everyone stands
Lorne threatens to walk with the money and Darius blocks him
Marisol bluffs a weapon in her pocket and forces Darius back
Lorne takes the twelve stacks and Marisol shows him out
Vinnie exhales; Marisol admits it was a stapler, Darius laughs
Vinnie reveals cash bricks and orders a recount as the shop bell rings

s01483.summary: Desta beaches the canoe and admits she lied about the camp
Kipp finds signs someone lived here; Desta deflects to eating
Kipp finds fresh tally notches and Desta tells him not to touch
Kipp presses Desta, who admits she has been here before
Kipp sees a child's boot and a fresh notch meant for him

s00477.summary: Deshawn finds a man in a bathrobe on a showroom bed
The sleepless man begs ten minutes on the mattress
Gilbert gives his hyphenated name and cites a dreamed manager blessing
Deshawn sits and recalls his mother's bed; both lie down and snore

s00126.summary: Five players gather around a card table on a dark roller rink
Players trade barbs about house rules, cheating and Sato's wire
Mouse spots a sixth chair; Slim says it's for a collector
Pushed by Slim, Teddy admits he sold out the Bay Street job
Sato orders stillness as the rink doors swing open

s00771.summary: Rosalind finds a stranger on her ferry bench
Rosalind recognizes Elias after twenty years
Grandson Teo asks who he is; Rosalind sends him away
Rosalind reassures the deckhand and sits near Elias

s00692.summary: Fola and Reuben sweep the warehouse and find dropped keys
A stranger appears and they train guns on him
The stranger knows Fola's name and plants doubt about Lagos
Imelda emerges with a pistol to Reuben's neck, demanding the ledger
Nikolai says the ledger names everyone; Imelda cocks her pistol

s02331.summary: Jonah lingers at the bakery trading jabs with Pilar
Jonah gives Pilar a single cherry and steps closer
Her landlord arrives warning the roof leaks onto the dough
A drip lands on a loaf and Jonah crowns it with the cherry

s00954.summary: On the saloon roof the sheriff's group idles and banters over pie
Obadiah silences them as distant hoofbeats swell
Obadiah orders everyone down and a stampede tears into town
Jed laughs it off, but Obadiah points out masked riders with torches
Obadiah rises and draws his revolver
